title: Integrated omics and machine learning find glutathione and citrate reduce nanoparticle toxicity in microglia
summary: A machine-learning algorithm integrated transcriptome, proteome and metabolome data into one network and screened 19 compounds for predicted effects on silica-coated magnetic nanoparticle toxicity. Glutathione plus citrate attenuated toxicity in BV2 and primary microglia and for ten other nanoparticles, and protected hippocampus and thalamus in mice. The algorithm name and link of the combination to the model output were not fully confirmed; preclinical.

evidence.tested: In vitro microglia experiments and in vivo mouse brain experiments.
